summary: The story keeps a promise decision 0016 made and never implemented, and it does so in the harness's own idiom: refusals name the repair, validation precedes mutation, and project-owned content is reported rather than edited. The final pass reports no in-scope defect (0.96). The recurring quality theme was refusals whose stated repair could not actually be executed, or whose scope was defined by a naming convention rather than by evidence.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The counterpart refusal told the human to delete the path and re-run while leaving the target dirty, which the dirty-target gate then rejected. Validation now runs before the first write, and a test asserts the worktree is still clean after a refusal.

The stale-reference report could print 'none' while project-owned files still named the retired tree: carried client skills are untracked until staged, preserved skills at an exact path were filtered as harness-owned, and a surviving bare .agents file was discarded with the retired tree.

Translation from the legacy path keyed off every preserved name, including ones preserved from the current location whose legacy twin was deliberately skipped — naming a current file that had no stale reference.

Two tests asserted less than they appeared to: the identity test only detected the calendar bug on days 1-9, and the pycache test force-added its artifact, making it tracked and therefore not the untracked case it existed to cover.

After this review was recorded, upgrade.py changed once: it read the target's project-owned harness.yaml unconditionally and crashed on a legacy repo that has none — the normal case for the repos this command upgrades — after the writes had landed. Fixed in PR #37, covered by a regression test, local autoreview clean at 0.95, and verified end to end against a real legacy repo. Recorded here so this artifact does not read as having reviewed code it predates.

residual_risks: A ledgered quickfix taken while a stage is open wedges that stage: stage done has no notion of quickfix-attributed paths, and stage start has no --base to re-baseline honestly. Hit during this story and worked around by re-recording the scope; it will recur and deserves its own story.
PRESERVE_IN_AGENTS keeps a name left over from the rename while holding factory/ paths. Deliberately not renamed here — it is not this story's diff.
